Support Tartiflette here: https://www.patreon.com/tartiflette

aiDescription: Provides a Luxurious Bronze color scheme for the Diable Avionics faction. Includes new skins for Virtuous and Gust variants using the Magic Lib paintjob framework. Covers all content from the latest official release and includes unused theme-fitting sprites for missiles, hullmods, stations, and campaign props.
saveCompatibilityText: This mod can be enabled and disabled at any time.

changelog.0.98a:
-new Virtuous skin
-new Gust skin
-now using Magic Lib paintjob framework
-updated to cover all content as per latest official Diable Avionics release and as far as supported by Magic Lib features
-also included (unused for now) theme fitting missiles, hullmods, station and campaign prop sprites
